item.text:
This pass checked F27’s actual impact in a full cluster. With one replica holding a PREACCEPTED value and four empty replicas, captured recovery falls through to sub-case 5 and commits NOOP on all five replicas. That is live and safe for an unchosen value, so the missing TryPreAccept branch is not required for this simple case ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_subcase4_cluster_output.txt)).

That tempers F27: the concern is the untested TryPreAccept recovery path and the 85/500 recoveries that remain stalled in PREACCEPTED when the threshold is guessed, not a demonstrated safety failure in the single-PREACCEPT scenario. The naive guard remains a negative diagnostic; F6/F12/F17 fixes do not rescue it.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. The cluster control and corrected F27 interpretation are recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
